name: Urban VR
summary:
Express yourself freely. Create and share your art.
You can paint on every wall, pavement, car, metro and more.
Breathtaking rooftops. For thrill-seekers, you can access the rooftops via the vertical lift or the ladder.
Go from rooftops to subway through the streets without changing the map.
Turn this area into one giant graffiti.

You can export your drawing with transparent background in 2k or 4k.
All you need is an email address to retrieve your work in HD quality.
